what: Spot illustrations for the website (Open Flow 0.2, Daylight; DEC-20261025-A).
made_with: ChatGPT image generation, run through the Codex CLI (codex-cli 0.153.4, image_generation feature) under the founder subscription, on 2026-10-25. One brief per image, first generation, no retouching. Downscaled to 1024px and saved as WebP (quality 86); transparent output flattened onto white.
rights: Generated for Strale; no third-party artwork, logos, text or likenesses were requested or appear.

items.brief:
A spot illustration for a developer website, square 1:1, on a pure white background (#ffffff) with generous empty margin (at least 12% on every side) so it sits on a white page with no visible edge.

Subject: a floating web page card (browser window shape with pale grey bars) with a large glass magnifying lens in front of it; the lens rim is a blue ribbon and a violet ribbon flows from its handle, carrying two small clean text-card chips away to the right.

Brand language: the objects are made of, or connected by, smooth glossy flowing ribbons in the brand colours: electric blue #3027ff, violet #7b2cff and teal #039490, with soft pink-lilac highlights #f3c9f5. Neutral objects (paper, cards, screens) are white or very pale grey with soft rounded corners.

Style: refined, calm, premium. Soft matte 3D with gentle gradients and one subtle soft shadow beneath the group, like high-end product illustration (Stripe or Linear marketing art). Same lighting from the upper left. Not cartoonish. No characters, no faces, no hands. No text, letters, numbers, flags or logos anywhere in the image; stand-in text is pale grey bars. Clean edges, crisp silhouette, lots of white space, one clear subject.
